title: Build and install pMARS from Debian source without X11
query: Build pMARS from source with no X server. Since koth.org is unreliable, obtain the source from Debian packages instead, extract it to `/app/pmars-<version>/`, and build it there without X11 support. Leave the source tree in place and install the binary to `/usr/local/bin/pmars`. The build can be tested with `pmars -b -r 50 -f flashpaper.red rave.red | tail -n 1`, which should output "Results: X Y Z" with integer values. The binary must have no X11 dependencies and the debugger must work properly.
